# routeros_iot_mqtt_brokers (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Descriptive name of the broker.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `address` (String) IP address or hostname of the broker. Must be set for the client to be able to connect.
- `auto_connect` (Boolean) Keeps the connection to the broker up and reconnects automatically when it drops.
- `certificate` (String) Name of the certificate from `/certificate` used for the SSL connection.
- `client_id` (String) Unique client ID used for the MQTT connection.
- `keep_alive` (Number) Time in seconds between the client pings sent to the broker. MikroTik documents the range as 30..64800, default `60`.
- `parallel_scripts_limit` (String) Maximum number of scripts that the `on-message` subscription handler may run in parallel. Accepts `off` (no limit tracking, the default) or a number; MikroTik documents the numeric range as 3..1000.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password used to authenticate to the broker, if the broker requires one.
- `port` (Number) Network port used by the broker. Default: `1883`.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Use a TLS/SSL protected connection to the broker.
- `username` (String) Username used to authenticate to the broker, if the broker requires one.
- `will_message` (String) Last Will and Testament message published by the broker on an unexpected disconnect.
- `will_qos` (Number) Quality of Service value used for the Last Will and Testament message. MQTT defines `0`, `1` and `2`.
- `will_retain` (Boolean) Whether the broker should retain the Last Will and Testament message.
- `will_topic` (String) Topic the Last Will and Testament message is published to.

### Read-Only

- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the client is currently connected to the broker.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
